page.layout: One printed page (left) with running head and page number at top. Main column: verse couplets numbered 18 to 28, each in italic, one stanza per couplet, numbers at the left of the column. Below, a centred title "SYMBOLA MONITORIA" with "Capitum." beneath, then a list set in italic with numbers 1 to 20 above and between the words, ending with "Zona," at the right as catchword. Right-hand printed page only partly visible at the far right edge: not transcribed.

p.i: 18 Vera Corinthe probas. Paulum tibi Gallio sistunt, Quem Priscilla docet, victor ubique volat.
19 Abluti rursum. dissertio, signaque Pauli. Ardentes libri magna Diana sonant.
20 Blandè sopitus moritur. Paulusque vocatos Bellè facta viros, moxque futura docet.
21 Constrictæ palmæ, uti simulatio duplex Compes. Tarsensem Græca loquela probat.
22 Denarrat Paulus, quo verterit ordine sectam Dic mihi, Romanus sisne, Tribunus ait.
23 Eriperis pervim, tua cædes, Paule, vouetur. Et per te mitti Dux sua scripta Duci.
24 Facundi Paulus Tertulli verba refutat. Fœlix rem differt, munus habere volens.
25 Gratificaturus Paulum vult mittere Festus, Gnarus at [?]is dixit, Cæsarem adire volo.
26 Illicet Agrippam narrans quæcunque patrasset, Insanis, inquit præses: at ille negat.
27 Longa maris patimur discrimina, denique nantes Luctantesque diu, proxima terra capit.
28 Morderis, pellis febrem. Romamque profectus, Mordes iure tuos Paule, diuque doces.

l.i: Supplet, Flatinges, Claudus salit, Actio, Fraufque;

page.notes: The right-hand printed page is cut off at the right edge of the scan and is not transcribed. The word "Zona," at the lower right is treated as the catchword. The long s is printed as a plain s throughout; where it looks like f (fistunt, differtio, feslam), it has been read as s. "[?]" marks "is" in line 25, which is hard to read. "sectam" in line 22 and "differt" in line 24 are uncertain readings of the long s. The "10" in the list sits between the lines and is placed as its own line. The small mark at the bottom centre of the page is a stain and is not transcribed.
